_meta.purpose: Real hotel data + one official/representative photo URL per hotel, to replace duplicate/generic placeholder images on the trip pages.
notes: currentImage = path referenced by the hotel-card on the trip page.

photoUrl prefers the hotel's OWN official domain; where the official site only serves lazy-loaded/data-URI or thumbnail images, a verified direct URL is given when possible, otherwise photoSource page URL is given and photoUrl is the best constructible/representative URL or null.
Several hotels appear on two trips (Sharm physical hotels are shared between cairo-sharm and sharm-constantine) - same real hotel, different card id/image file.
